expectations.text: The bedroom prompt explicitly specifies a three-quarter (3/4) camera angle into the room showing two walls / depth of the space
expectations.evidence: Prompt: 'camera at a three-quarter angle into the room showing two walls and the depth of the space, eye-level.' QA reinforces: 'Depth visible? You can feel the 3/4 angle — two walls and real depth between them. A flat, wall-facing shot → reject.'

expectations.text: The bedroom prompt describes the layout spatially — object positions relative to walls, window, and each other — not just an inventory list
expectations.evidence: 'Layout: single bed against the far wall directly under the window...; wooden desk against the right wall...; open toy chest near the left wall...; door in the left wall standing ajar; crayon drawings taped to the wall above the desk.'

expectations.text: The response recommends NOT generating an image asset for the beach, advising to describe it directly in the video prompt instead
expectations.evidence: '2) Generic sunny beach — SKIP the asset... Describe it directly in the video prompt, e.g.: "a wide sunny beach, golden sand, gentle turquoise waves..."' No beach image prompt is provided.

expectations.text: The response includes physical-coherence QA guidance: reject plates with floating/unsupported/unattached objects and regenerate rather than fix
expectations.evidence: 'One levitating toy means the model was sloppy everywhere — discard the whole image and regenerate a new batch, don't try to fix it.' Plus 'Everything supported? No floating toys or books...' and 'Everything attached and connected?' checks.

eval_feedback.overall: No suggestions — assertions map directly to the skill's generate-vs-skip decision logic and physics QA.
